Turn it on?

toolbox.migration_notice.title: Moved over from OnionHEN
toolbox.migration_notice.body:
An existing OnionHEN installation was found on this console.

Your settings, payloads, plugins and cheats were copied from /data/OnionHEN to /data/AniketosHEN. The OnionHEN folder was not changed or deleted, so you can go back to OnionHEN at any time.

The copy is made only once. From now on AniketosHEN uses its own folder only; you can delete /data/OnionHEN yourself when you no longer need it.

toolbox.kbm.help.sub: Profiles, layers, bindings and the mouse
toolbox.kbm.help.1: Each game uses its own profile or, if it has none, the default profile.
toolbox.kbm.help.2: A binding links an input (a key, mouse button, wheel or mouse movement, optionally with modifier keys such as Shift) to up to four outputs: buttons, stick directions, triggers, layers or macros.
toolbox.kbm.help.3: Layers sit on top of the base layer. Hold or toggle a layer to change bindings and mouse settings, for example a slower mouse while aiming.
toolbox.kbm.help.4: The mouse moves a stick. Velocity mode suits cameras and aiming; Position mode suits steering.
toolbox.kbm.help.5: Stick directions and triggers can ramp up. For racing, W → R2 with a 300 ms rise feels like a throttle.
toolbox.kbm.help.6: Changes are saved at once and reach a running game within a moment. The pause key switches the mapping off and on.

toolbox.kbm.ramp.rise.sub: Time to reach full strength while held; 0 is instant
toolbox.kbm.ramp.fall.sub: Time to return after release; 0 is instant

toolbox.kbm.mouse.mode.sub: Velocity: mouse speed moves the stick (aim, camera). Position: mouse travel holds the stick (steering).

toolbox.kbm.mouse.boost.sub: Extra speed for fast flicks; 1.00 is off
toolbox.kbm.mouse.range.sub: Position mode: mouse travel for full stick deflection
toolbox.kbm.mouse.spring.sub: Position mode: how fast the stick returns when the mouse stops
